course_summary:
ISEN 620 | Survey of Optimization | Fall 2026
Instructor: Sergiy Butenko | butenko@tamu.edu
Meets: Asynchronous | Online
Grading: Exams [20%], Homework Quizzes [15%], Lecture Quizzes [5%] — A: [90,100], B: [80,90), C: [70,80), D: [60,70), F: [0,60)
Topics: Karush-Kuhn-Tucker Conditions, K-K-T conditions, Complementary Slackness, Simplex Method in Matrix Form, Steepest Descent Method, Newton's Method, Conjugate Direction Methods, Lagrange conditions, FONC for Equality Constraints, FONC for Unconstrained Problems, Second Order Optimality Conditions, Root Finding, Line Search, Graphical Method, Simplex Method, Termination, Initialization, Analysis of the Simplex Method, LP Duality, Sensitivity Analysis, IP Modeling, LP Modeling, LP Assumptions, deterministic linear optimization, deterministic nonlinear optimization, linear programming, unconstrained-nonlinear optimization, constrained-nonlinear optimization, numerical algorithms, linear programming theory, nonlinear programming theory, linear programming algorithms, nonlinear programming algorithms, linear optimization models, nonlinear optimization models, small-scale optimization problems, large-scale optimization problems, Introduction to Optimization Software, Nonlinear Opt. Preliminaries
Tools: AMPL, Excel, Solver add-on, Canvas, GroupMe, Zoom
Prerequisites: MATH 304, MATH 311
